protocol.actual_duration_note: enrollment/query pools use whole independent mic1 utterances and stop after reaching the requested VAD speech budget; actual VAD seconds including final-utterance overshoot are recorded
protocol.attempt_dependence: query attempts within an identity and cross-fold re-use are clustered by speaker; confidence intervals resample speaker-level rates
enrollment_pooling: mean of L2-normalized utterance embeddings for the validation-selected head
protocol.evaluation_speakers: speaker-disjoint 30-person fold role; no evaluation identity used for head training, model selection, or threshold fitting
protocol.focus: 10 seconds enrollment, 8 registered identities; selected validation head, selected-head mean of normalized utterance embeddings, pre_encoder mean+std cosine, and encoder.layer.7 mean cosine; threshold retained from 15 calibration speakers only
protocol.native_channel_comparison: not rerun: existing channel baseline constructs AOSC state from an ordered conversation and is not equivalent to this fresh-stream single-utterance representation protocol; historical Task08/09A counts are not directly comparable
protocol.open_set_policy: top-1 prototype cosine accepted only at or above threshold; otherwise UNKNOWN; no free native diarization channel is required
protocol.prototype_aggregation: one cosine to each identity prototype; no max over per-user prototypes
protocol.query_buckets: VAD speech seconds grouped by actual utterance duration: under 2, 2 to 5, 5 to 10, over 10 seconds; per-speaker 500-resample cluster intervals; query budgets remain separately identified because grouping can reuse source utterances across budgets

query_duration_buckets.under_2s: individual query utterances below 2.0s VAD speech

protocol.threshold: one frozen model-specific threshold per fold fitted only on calibration speakers by leave-one-identity-out max impostor cosine; same threshold at every test duration and registry size
